**Risk flags:**
- Single shareholder holds 90.66%
- Only 2 year(s) of financials available  

**Overview:**  
Everbright Teguh Hotel Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited boutique hotel operating in Kuantan, Selangor, within the hospitality industry. The company was incorporated on 1989-07-29 and currently has five directors. Its share capital is RM500,000, with a single shareholder controlling 90.66% of equity. Reported revenues are RM6,227,194 and RM6,520,818 for the two available financial periods, with equity of RM2,062,921 and RM2,481,753 respectively. The firm has five directors and no pending litigation.
